bands.summary: ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit convenes in Kazan with bilateral meetings, prisoner releases, and Vietnam-Russia and Philippines-Russia talks alongside ongoing war reporting from Ukraine.

bands.label: Post-invasion isolation push
bands.summary: Russia faces Western sanctions and diplomatic isolation after invading Ukraine, prompting outreach to ASEAN, Africa, Cuba, and other non-aligned partners to sustain trade and political ties.

frames.label: Jun 2026 Kazan summit
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins with the ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit in Kazan in June 2026, where Marcos met Putin, Vietnam discussed cooperation, and 24 Filipinos were released. This is the frame Philippine and Russian state outlets open with, reading the moment as a fresh diplomatic engagement on its own terms.

frames.label: Feb 2022 Ukraine invasion
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins with Russia's February 2022 invasion of Ukraine, which made every subsequent Russian summit an act of breaking isolation. This is the frame Kyiv Independent, Ukrainian outlets, and G7-aligned commentators open with, reading the Kazan meetings as sanctions-evasion outreach rather than routine diplomacy.
